processes.missing_deal_setup_or_extension: Logistics or settlements staff ask the deal owner to create, extend or correct a deal ticket so that flowing volumes at a meter can be allocated and billed.
processes.deal_price_invoice_discrepancy: Settlements or accounting staff chase and reconcile mismatches between invoiced and booked deal price, volume, or path with the trader or counterparty.
processes.meter_allocation_exception_resolution: Staff investigate meter volume, allocation, or confirmation exceptions across POPS/MOPS/UA4 and get a decision from the deal owner to clear errors.
processes.nomination_change_processing: Customers and operators send monthly or revised gas nominations and scheduling changes that the desk must key in and correct.
processes.on_call_notes_distribution: Weekend on-call notes are compiled and emailed to the desk after each on-call period.
